scripts.type-check: pnpm run generate:data && pnpm run generate:routes && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --project ./tsconfig.json
scripts.build: pnpm run generate:data && pnpm run generate:routes && vite build --config app.config.ts
scripts.deploy: VITE_GIT_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) pnpm run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:dry-run: VITE_GIT_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) pnpm run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config dist/server/wrangler.json
